title: How many accounts who have region in Prague are eligible for loans?
question: How many accounts who have region in Prague are eligible for loans?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(T1.account_id)
FROM account AS T1
INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
INNER JOIN disp AS T3 ON T1.account_id = T3.account_id
WHERE T2.A3 = 'Prague'
  AND T3.type = 'OWNER'
